title: Taming the Monster: A Fast and Simple Algorithm for Contextual Bandits
summary: This paper presents a fast and simple algorithm for contextual bandits that achieves optimal regret bounds with only Õ(√(KT/log N)) oracle calls across T rounds, vastly improving upon prior work. The algorithm uses a coordinate descent procedure to compute a sparse distribution over policies and an epoch-based structure for efficient updates. The authors provide theoretical analysis and experimental validation demonstrating superior computational and prediction performance compared to existing approaches.
